nodes.notes: status comes from Delivery Gate: awaiting_approval, or changes_requested when the plan is held. A held version cannot be approved: no approval email is sent for it, and Re-request approval only accepts approval_timeout.

nodes.name: Held Notice

parameters.subject: ={{ 'HELD, not sent for approval: ' + ($('Prepare Client Data').first().json.package || 'Unknown') + ' plan for ' + String($('Prepare Client Data').first().json.client_name || '').trim().replace(/\b\w/g, c => c.toUpperCase()) }}
parameters.message:
={{ (() => { const g = $('Delivery Gate').first().json; const v = $('Insert Plan Version').first().json; const c = $('Prepare Client Data').first().json; return 'This plan is HELD. It was not sent for approval and cannot be approved or delivered in this state.

Client: ' + String(c.client_name || '').trim() + '
Order: ' + v.submission_id + '
Version: ' + v.version + '
Plan version ID: ' + v.id + '
Review status: ' + g.review_status + '

Why it is held: ' + g.reason + '

DELIVERY BLOCKERS (' + g.blocker_count + ', each must be fixed before this plan can be delivered)
' + g.blockers_text + '

WARNINGS (' + g.warning_count + ', these do not block delivery by themselves)
' + g.warnings_text + '

Diagnostic PDF, for review only, valid 72 hours:
https://yglmlnfsyzsvozxirlpo.supabase.co/storage/v1' + $('Create Held Link').first().json.signedURL + '

FULL REVIEW REPORT
' + ($('Finalize Plan').first().json.report || ''); })() }}

nodes.notes: Internal notice only. A held plan gets no approval email, so it has no Approve button.
